rename.title: RenameDialog · Rename groups and projects
rename.description: Try the rename dialog for groups and projects. Topics are renamed inline in the chat list.
rename.options: The caller supplies dialogTitle, description and placeholder. title sets the initial value; onConfirm receives the trimmed title. Empty titles cannot be saved.

delete.title: DeleteConfirm · Delete confirmation
delete.description: Compare deletion of one chat, multiple chats, or a chat with automations.
delete.options: count controls bulk deletion copy. automations shows linked jobs, schedules and next runs. Confirm calls onConfirm.
delete.hint: Choose a single chat, multiple chats, or a chat with automations.

inlineTokens.title: Inline tokens · Commands and session handles
inlineTokens.description: Edit commands and handles to see highlighting and stable session colors.
inlineTokens.options: SlashCommandText takes command; InlineTokenHighlight takes color and content. SessionHandleLabel derives its color from id.

sessionLinks.hint: Select a session mention to see feedback.

userText.title: UserMessageText · Message mentions
userText.description: Edit a message with skill, app, MCP and session mentions.
userText.options: text is the original message. cliApps, mcpPresets and sessionMentions resolve mentions. Skills use $name; other mentions use @name.

capabilityTokens.title: CapabilityMentionToken · App mentions
capabilityTokens.description: Compare app, MCP and session mentions in the composer and messages.
capabilityTokens.options: segment specifies cli, mcp or session and its metadata. variant selects composer or message. This example uses a local brand image.

productIcons.title: Product icons · Icon catalog
productIcons.description: Browse product icons, change their size and select a highlight.
productIcons.options: Icons accept LucideProps such as size, strokeWidth and className. Color inherits currentColor; buttons have accessible action names.

startup.title: StartupShell · Startup placeholder
startup.description: Preview the quiet placeholder while the app connects.
startup.options: embedded renders a section; otherwise the element is main. aria-busy and loading status remain available. Placeholder styles come from the app entry.

fileActions.title: FileActions · File menu
fileActions.description: Right-click a file to copy its full path, relative path or reference text.
fileActions.options: path is the reference text. metadata supplies the full path and optional relative path. The Gallery supplies metadata without loading a file.
fileActions.hint: Right-click for the copy menu, or focus the file and press Shift+F10.

workbench.title: PaneWorkbench · Multiple panes
workbench.description: Switch layouts, activate or add panes, and adjust their position and size.
workbench.options: The caller controls panes, activePaneKey, layout and splitRatios. renderPane supplies content; callbacks update local preview state. Narrow screens show the active pane.
workbench.activate: Select this pane to activate it
workbench.hint: Active: {{title}}. Drag the bottom handle to move a pane; drag its edges to resize.

hostConnection.title: HostConnectionStatus · Connection status
hostConnection.description: Compare connected, disconnected, connecting and error states.
hostConnection.options: state controls the icon and text. compact hides visible text but keeps the accessible status and tooltip.

compatibility.title: HostCompatibilityDialog · Version compatibility
compatibility.description: Inspect versions, preparation notes and the upgrade guide for each compatibility result.
compatibility.options: A profile opens the dialog; compatibility supplies the result and versions. onClose closes it. This component only displays information.

composer.title: ThreadComposer · Message input
composer.description: Try sending messages, attachments, commands and quotes in busy and disabled states.
composer.options: A successful onSend clears the input. isStreaming controls stopping and queuing; variant selects thread or welcome-page styling. Submissions stay in this preview.
composer.placeholder: Type a message, or / for commands
composer.hint: Try sending a message, selecting attachments, switching models and opening commands.

modelPreset.title: ModelPresetBadge · Model presets
modelPreset.description: Try the model menu, keyboard navigation and setup state.
modelPreset.options: modelPresets supplies presets; modelPreset and onPresetChange control selection. needsSetup shows the setup entry.
modelPreset.hint: Current preset: {{preset}}. Open the menu or use arrow keys to switch.

usage.title: ComposerUsagePopover · Context usage
usage.description: View context, cache and generation time with warning states and a bottom sheet.
usage.options: context supplies capacity; rounds supplies per-round statistics. bottomSheet selects the mobile panel.
usage.hint: Open usage details for context, cache and generation time per round.

workspace.title: WorkspaceControls · Working directory
workspace.description: Choose an example project and change this preview’s access mode.
workspace.options: scope and onChange control selection; onLoadProjects supplies example directories. The gateway resolves real paths and enforces permissions.

navigator.title: PromptNavigator · Message navigation
navigator.description: Search earlier questions and inspect the jump callback.
navigator.options: messages supplies the full conversation; the component extracts user questions. onJumpToPrompt receives the target message ID.
navigator.hint: Open message navigation, then search and select a question.

header.title: ThreadHeader · Chat header
header.description: Try the sidebar, theme, temporary chat and message navigation controls.
header.options: title, handle, theme and temporaryChatEnabled supply display state. Callbacks pass actions to the caller.

messages.title: ThreadMessages · Message list
messages.description: Explore a multi-turn conversation, message menus, branches and selected-text quotes.
messages.options: messages contains projected messages. onForkFromMessage receives a user-question index; onQuoteSelection receives selected answer text.
messages.hint: Open a message menu, or select answer text and choose Quote.

viewport.title: ThreadViewport · Chat scrolling
viewport.description: Scroll a long conversation with question markers, navigation and return to bottom.
viewport.options: The preview has a fixed height. messages drives history; ref.jumpToUserPrompt locates a question. emptyState supplies empty-chat content.
viewport.empty: Type a message to start a chat
viewport.hint: Scroll to explore question markers, or use navigation and return to the bottom.

history.title: ThreadHistoryStatus · History status
history.description: Show loading, the beginning of history, and errors with retry.
history.options: loading indicates a request, exhausted means there are no earlier messages, error supplies error details, and onRetry retries loading.

recovery.title: RecoveryNotice · Task recovery
recovery.description: Compare interrupted, resuming, failed and unavailable states; try Continue and Dismiss.
recovery.options: state supplies a recovery snapshot. onContinue and onDismiss return Promises. These callbacks only update the preview.
recovery.hint: Select a recovery state, then try continuing or dismissing.

fallback.title: ModelFallbackNotice · Model fallback
fallback.description: View fallback-model and expired-authorization notices, settings and dismissal.
fallback.options: model identifies the fallback model; reauthProviderLabel names the expired authorization. The caller supplies onOpenSettings and onDismiss.
fallback.hint: Try the model settings link and dismiss button.

compaction.title: ContextCompactionNotice · Context compaction
compaction.description: Compare compaction started, succeeded, failed and cancelled states.
compaction.options: compaction.phase selects the notice; announce controls screen-reader announcements.

streamError.title: StreamErrorNotice · Message errors
streamError.description: Compare message size, directory permission, turn rejection and model request errors.
streamError.options: error.kind selects the error message; onDismiss closes the notice.

cluster.title: AgentActivityCluster · Full activity
cluster.description: View reasoning and tool records in running, completed and failed states.
cluster.options: messages contains reasoning and trace projections. isTurnStreaming controls activity; expanded can be caller-controlled.
cluster.error: The file could not be read.

search.title: WebSearchRun · Search activity
search.description: View search progress and sources for web and X searches.
search.options: run supplies query, target, status and sources; turnActive controls the running effect. Shared components load source-site icons.

responseSources.title: FallbackResponseSources · Response sources
responseSources.description: View the fallback presets, models and providers used by earlier replies.
responseSources.options: sources preserves the model snapshot at response time. Only sources with fallback set to true show a badge.
responseSources.hint: Select a fallback badge to see the preset, model and provider used for that response.

filePreview.title: FilePreviewPanelView · File content
filePreview.description: Compare text, images, truncation, loading and errors. Select an image to zoom.
filePreview.options: state supplies a display snapshot; path determines the file type and name. Image open and error callbacks update the preview.

session.title: SessionInfoPopoverView · Session automations
session.description: View, edit, disable and delete jobs, with loading and error states.
session.options: The caller supplies jobs, loading, loadFailed and now. onAction and onEdit return updated jobs; the view coordinates dialogs, focus and feedback.
session.hint: Open session details to view, toggle, edit and delete automations.

subagent.title: SubagentThreadView · Subagent messages
subagent.description: View subagent messages, reasoning, loading and failure; try the retry callback.
subagent.options: The runtime projects messages. loading and error use the shared history status; isStreaming and activeTurnId identify activity. The view does not fetch history.

pairRoute.title: PairRouteSettingsView · Pairing route
pairRoute.description: Select and locally save routes, with saved, saving, error and refresh-failure states.
pairRoute.options: The caller manages route and original; routes supplies SSH routes. Save success and directory refresh failure are shown separately. Gallery and settings share this view.

quickPair.title: QuickPairSetupView · Quick pairing
quickPair.description: Try invitation copying, receipt entry, access confirmation, existing hosts and retries.
quickPair.options: state supplies pairing and display state; callbacks perform actions. routeSettings composes route settings. Gallery uses fixtures and local callbacks; QuickPairSetup manages real pairing.
quickPair.hint: Example invitations and receipts are for display only. Confirmation updates local feedback.

sshHost.title: SSHHostPickerView · SSH address
sshHost.description: Filter SSH aliases, select with arrow keys, and compare import, loading and error states.
sshHost.options: discovery supplies hosts from the current config. The caller controls value, busy, error and callbacks. customConfig retains custom-config alias discovery; inputRef restores focus after selection.
sshHost.hint: Type to filter addresses; use arrow keys to select an SSH alias.

connectionBadge.title: ConnectionBadge · Connection indicator
connectionBadge.description: Compare connection colors, animations and accessible status text.
connectionBadge.options: The caller supplies status. The page container owns the connection subscription.

hostPicker.title: HostSwitcherView · Host menu
hostPicker.description: Choose local or example hosts; compare pending, offline and collapsed states.
hostPicker.options: picker supplies host data and callbacks; status is the current connection state. Production HostSwitcher subscribes to the client.

chats.title: ChatList · Chat list
chats.description: Select chats and try pinning, archiving and deleting from their menus.
chats.options: The caller supplies sessions, activeKey and pinned/archived keys. Action callbacks update the example list.

sidebarResize.title: SidebarResizeHandle · Sidebar size
sidebarResize.description: Resize, collapse and expand the sidebar with the mouse or keyboard.
sidebarResize.options: width and open are controlled. onResize updates size and expansion; onDraggingChange reports dragging.
sidebarResize.hint: Drag the divider, or focus it and use arrow keys, Home, End and Enter.

language.title: LanguageSwitcher · Interface language
language.description: Switch the language of the Gallery and production components.
language.options: Uses the app’s i18n and browser language preference, without a gateway. The top language selector is the same component.

channelMarks.title: Channel marks · Channel identity
channelMarks.description: View avatar fallback text, workspace icons and the WebSocket mark.
channelMarks.options: LinearAvatar takes name, url and workspace. Without a valid image, it shows fallback text or an icon.
channelMarks.name: Avatar name

secret.title: LinearSecretField · Secret editing
secret.description: Edit, reveal, save and replace a secret; check draft retention after a failed save.
secret.options: configured indicates saved state; onSave persists the secret. Gallery callbacks only update local state.
secret.hint: Enter example text and save, or select the error state to check draft retention.

channelHelp.title: LinearHelpContent · Channel help
channelHelp.description: View channel help inside the real dropdown menu.
channelHelp.options: Content uses existing channel translations; the caller supplies the menu container.

channel.title: {{channel}} · Channel setup
channel.description: Explore the real channel setup form and states.
channel.options: Uses channel registrations, Python setup-contract snapshots and production ChannelSetupSurfaceView. Inputs, credential visibility, presets, checks and toggles affect only this preview.
channel.credentialsError: Example credentials were rejected. Update the preview values and try again.

channelConnect.error: Authorization is temporarily unavailable. Try again.

qqConnect.title: QQConnectFlowView · QQ QR connection
qqConnect.description: Explore QQ QR login, retries and the App Secret replacement warning.
qqConnect.options: The view receives connection state and callbacks. Preview actions stay local; the runtime entry creates sessions and polls the QQ portal.

feishuConnect.title: FeishuConnectFlowView · Feishu QR authorization
feishuConnect.description: Try the real Feishu QR flow with waiting, success, expiry, cancellation and errors.
feishuConnect.options: connect, busy and error supply display state; QR codes are generated locally. The feature owns start, cancel and polling; preview callbacks change only this example.

feishuAssistants.title: FeishuAssistantsPanelView · Feishu assistants
feishuAssistants.description: Explore assistant cards, runtime and authorization states, toggles, advanced settings and adding an assistant.
feishuAssistants.options: feature and instances supply assistant snapshots. The view owns drafts and save feedback; onToggleInstance, onSaveInstance and renderConnectFlow connect runtime actions.
feishuAssistants.error: The assistant stopped. Check its credentials before restarting.

whatsappConnect.title: WhatsAppConnectFlowView · WhatsApp device linking
whatsappConnect.description: Compare automatic linking, success, expiry and errors in the minimal QR layout; try linking another account.
whatsappConnect.options: The view preserves automatic-start and minimal-layout display rules. The caller controls state and retries. The real connection entry owns automatic start, forced retries and polling.

linearPanel.title: LinearPanelView · Linear setup
linearPanel.description: Explore app details, secrets, advanced settings, workspaces, member access and browser authorization.
linearPanel.options: state and workspaces supply snapshots; callbacks connect workspace, save and MCP actions. Three slots compose production member, authorization and reset views.
linearPanel.runtimeError: The Linear webhook could not be started.
linearPanel.saveError: Settings could not be saved. Your draft was kept.
linearPanel.inspectionError: Connected workspaces could not be inspected.

linearMembers.title: LinearMemberAccessView · Member access
linearMembers.description: Search members, change access and compare loading, empty, saving and unconfirmed states.
linearMembers.options: snapshot contains confirmed member state. onLoad and onSetAllowed belong to the channel entry; the gateway still validates permissions.

linearConnect.title: LinearConnectFlowView · Linear authorization
linearConnect.description: Try browser authorization and waiting notices with start, cancel, success and failure stages.
linearConnect.options: Reuses ChannelQrConnectFlowView. Linear supplies browser authorization display, labels and focus handling; the runtime entry owns session creation and polling.
linearConnect.hint: The authorization link and workspace are examples. Start and Cancel only change the preview stage.

linearReset.title: LinearResetConnectionView · Reset connection
linearReset.description: Review what is cleared or kept, busy state and retries after a partial reset.
linearReset.options: onReset performs the full revocation and cleanup transaction. The view manages confirmation, errors, closing restrictions and focus restoration.
linearReset.error: The channel could not be stopped. App settings were kept.
linearReset.completed: Preview workspace and app settings cleared.

weixinPanel.title: WeixinPanelView · Weixin settings
weixinPanel.description: Explore Weixin settings, advanced options, save feedback and expired-login recovery.
weixinPanel.options: Fields come from the channel setup contract. The view owns expansion and secret visibility; the runtime entry owns autosave, draft merging and login recovery.

weixinConnect.title: WeixinConnectFlowView · Weixin QR and verification
weixinConnect.description: Compare QR scanning, verification codes, success, expiry, cancellation and connection errors.
weixinConnect.options: The view takes connection snapshots and callbacks, retaining the verification draft. QR codes are generated in the browser. The real entry owns authorization, polling pauses, refresh and cancellation.
weixinConnect.refreshed: A new preview QR code is displayed.
weixinConnect.hint: Enter 123456 to complete the verification preview. Other input keeps your draft and shows an error.
